knowledge:
- key_parameters: <HDExaminerFile=The input data frame containing uncurated HDX-MS results from HDExaminer ;; proteinStates=A character vector specifying the protein states to analyze (e.g., wt, iBET) ;; ecol=The column indices containing quantitative deuteration data (deprecated in favor of quantCols) ;; quantCols=The preferred parameter name replacing ecol for specifying quantitative columns ;; method=The imputation method used in the impute function, typically set to "zero" for zero timepoints ;; experiment=A character vector defining the experimental conditions/states ;; timepoints=A numeric vector specifying the timepoints for each sample in the experiment ;; peaks=A data frame containing peak information from HDsite for spectra comparison ;; object=A QFeatures object or data frame containing the HDX-MS data to be evaluated>
- alternatives: <None mentioned in the documentation, though the package relies on inputs generated from external software like HDExaminer and HDsite>
- when_to_use: <Use this package when you need to perform rigorous quality control on HDX-MS data before downstream analysis and publication, or as part of an iterative manual data curation process>
- pitfalls: <The ecol argument in readQFeatures is deprecated and triggers a warning; use quantCols instead ;; Missing values at zero timepoints should be filtered for non-random missingness using isMissingAtRandom before being imputed to zero ;; The sequence overlap check (compatibleUptake) defaults to checking sequences with up to 5 different exchangeable amides to keep runtimes low; larger differences may indicate chemical changes or back-exchange properties>

workflows.name: hdx_ms_quality_control
workflows.intent: Perform a complete quality control assessment on HDX-MS data, from raw HDExaminer output to a consolidated QC summary table.
input: BRD4_RowChecked_20220628_HDsite.csv (HDsite peaks file for spectra comparison)
workflows.stages: <1. Load and tidy HDExaminer data ;; 2. Convert data to a QFeatures object ;; 3. Visualize data and missingness ;; 4. Filter and impute missing values ;; 5. Compute and plot mass errors ;; 6. Detect and plot intensity outliers ;; 7. Analyze and plot retention time outliers ;; 8. Compute and plot monotonicity statistics ;; 9. Analyze and plot ion mobility outliers ;; 10. Calculate charge state correlations ;; 11. Assess replicate correlation and outliers ;; 12. Check sequence overlap compatibility ;; 13. Compare empirical and theoretical spectra ;; 14. Generate a consolidated quality control table>
workflows.code:
BRD4uncurated <- data.frame(read.csv(system.file("extdata", "ELN55049_AllResultsTables_Uncurated.csv", package = "hdxmsqc", mustWork = TRUE)))

BRD4uncurated_wide <- processHDE(HDExaminerFile = BRD4uncurated,
                                 proteinStates = c("wt", "iBET"))

i <- grep(pattern = "X..Deut",
          x = names(BRD4uncurated_wide))

BRD4df <- readQFeatures(assayData = BRD4uncurated_wide,
                        ecol = i,
                        names = "Deuteration",
                        fnames = "fnames")

pheatmap(assay(BRD4df), cluster_rows = FALSE, scale = "row")

plotMissing(object = BRD4df)

BRD4df_filtered <- isMissingAtRandom(object = BRD4df)

plotMissing(object = BRD4df_filtered)

BRD4df_filtered_imputed <- impute(BRD4df_filtered, method = "zero", i = 1)

massError <- computeMassError(object = BRD4df_filtered_imputed)
plotMassError(object = BRD4df_filtered_imputed)

intensityOutlier <- intensityOutliers(object = BRD4df_filtered_imputed)
plotIntensityOutliers(object = BRD4df_filtered_imputed)

dfrt <- rTimeOutliers(object = BRD4df_filtered_imputed)
plotrTimeOutliers(object = BRD4df_filtered_imputed)

experiment <- c("wt", "iBET")
timepoints <- rep(c(0, 15, 60, 600, 3600, 14000), each = 3)

monoStat <- computeMonotoneStats(object = BRD4df_filtered_imputed,
                                 experiment = experiment, 
                                 timepoints = timepoints)
out <- plotMonotoneStat(object = BRD4df_filtered_imputed,
                                 experiment = experiment, 
                                 timepoints = timepoints)

imTimeOut <- imTimeOutlier(object = BRD4df_filtered_imputed)
plotImTimeOutlier(object = BRD4df_filtered_imputed)

csCor <- chargeCorrelationHdx(object = BRD4df_filtered_imputed,
                              experiment = experiment,
                              timepoints = timepoints)

replicateVar <- replicateCorrelation(object = BRD4df_filtered_imputed,
                                     experiment = experiment,
                                     timepoints = timepoints)

replicateOut <- replicateOutlier(object = BRD4df_filtered_imputed,
                                     experiment = experiment,
                                     timepoints = timepoints)

tocheck <- compatibleUptake(object = BRD4df_filtered_imputed,
                 experiment = experiment,
                 timepoints = timepoints)

hdxsite <- data.frame(read.csv(system.file("extdata", "BRD4_RowChecked_20220628_HDsite.csv",
                                           package = "hdxmsqc", mustWork = TRUE),
                               header = TRUE, fileEncoding = 'UTF-8-BOM'))
BRD4matched <- read.csv(system.file("extdata", "BRD4_RowChecked_20220628_HDE.csv",
                                           package = "hdxmsqc", mustWork = TRUE),
                               header = TRUE, fileEncoding = 'UTF-8-BOM')

spectraCompare <- spectraSimilarity(peaks = hdxsite,
                                    object = BRD4matched, 
                                    experiment = experiment,
                                    numSpectra = NULL)

plotSpectraMirror(spectraCompare$observedSpectra[1,], spectraCompare$matchedSpectra[1,], ppm = 300)

qctable <- qualityControl(object = BRD4df_filtered_imputed, 
                           massError = massError,
                           intensityOutlier = intensityOutlier,
                           retentionOutlier = dfrt,
                           monotonicityStat = monoStat,
                           mobilityOutlier = imTimeOut,
                           chargeCorrelation = csCor,
                           replicateCorrelation = replicateVar,
                           replicateOutlier = replicateOut,
                           sequenceCheck = tocheck,
                           spectraCheck = spectraCompare,
                           experiment = experiment,
                           timepoints = timepoints )
